text: Siddharth, [heir to a royal family of Varanasi|who_suffers|heirs of old wrongs], returns from the United States with his archaeologist wife Avni to an ancestral palace said to be haunted by the dancer Manjulika. Long ago a Maharaja [publicly beheaded the man she loved|wrong|a life taken] and imprisoned her, and she hanged herself swearing vengeance on his successors. When Avni [opens the sealed door on the third floor|trigger|unsealing what was shut away], ghungroo bells and Bengali songs sound at night, and the psychiatrist Aditya comes to find [the haunting may live within the family|threat|the enemy within].
